title: Prime Minister shares an article by Union Ministers Shri Pralhad Joshi and Shri Shivraj Singh Chouhan highlighting the potential of agrivoltaics to boost farmers' incomes and advance rural prosperity
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, has shared an article written by Union Ministers, Shri Pralhad Joshi and Shri Shivraj Singh Chouhan.
In the article, Union Ministers Shri Pralhad Joshi and Shri Shivraj Singh Chouhan write about the potential of agrivoltaics to strengthen farmers' incomes by combining solar power generation with agriculture. It highlights how agrivoltaics can provide additional revenue, reduce energy costs and support crop productivity, offering an insightful perspective on powering farms and advancing rural prosperity.
The Prime Minister’s Office posted on X:
“Union Ministers Shri @JoshiPralhad and Shri @ChouhanShivraj write about the potential of agrivoltaics to strengthen farmers' incomes by combining solar power generation with agriculture. They highlight how it can provide additional revenue, reduce energy costs and support crop productivity. An insightful read on powering farms and advancing rural prosperity.
